row.reason: Customers overlap: both serve oil and gas operators/producers. Weatherford sells downhole drilling, completion, intervention and production tools and services to operators. Kinetik owns Delaware Basin midstream assets (gathering, compression, processing, transportation, water management). The offerings are different. Both earn service fees, but Weatherford also sells and rents equipment, while Kinetik runs pipelines and plants under long-term contracts.

C:P2.6.text: Texas crude oil reserves and natural gas reserves represent almost 25 percent and more than 30% of the U.S. total reserves, respectively. This prolific basin covers more than 75,000 square miles and 25 counties in West Texas and Eastern New Mexico.
